title: Schedule a Mac shutdown at a specific time
summary: Set your Mac to automatically shut down at a specific time of day, such as 1:00 PM. This is useful for powering off the computer after work hours.

steps.explain: This command schedules a system shutdown at 13:00 (1:00 PM). The time uses a 24-hour clock format (HHMM).

rollback.explain: To cancel a scheduled shutdown, run the shutdown command with the -c flag.

warnings: Ensure you save all work before the scheduled time.
The system will power off automatically at the specified time.
